newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up on strong sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up on strong sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares continued their strong run on Tuesday with bullish investors chasing blue chips and shares with a heavy weighting on the index, brokers said.
The index hit an intra-day high of 99.312 but profit-taking emerged below the key 100-point level, they said.
The B index surged 1.153 points or 1.19 percent to 97.970 on volume of 54.292 million shares worth $33.979 million.
More overseas capital was seen entering the market on Tuesday, brokers said, adding that they expected the index to rise further in the next few days.
"Both domestic and overseas investors' confidence was boosted," one broker said. "The market will see more fresh capital coming in over the short term."
All 43 B shares traded, with 20 up, five flat and 18 down.
Shanghai Worldbest was the star on institutional buying, surging $0.064 or 9.35 percent to $0.784 on volume of 2.7 million shares.
Market giant Shanghai Chlor Alkali was the most actively traded on overseas institutional buying, up $0.012 or 3.20 percent to $0.386 on volume of 7.2 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index continued its strong rising trend with speculative funds flowing in to the market pushing turnover to a two-year high of 15.7 billion yuan, brokers said.
The index rose 36.069 points or 2.38 percent to 1,549.372 points on volume of 1.1 billion shares.
The SSE30 blue chip index closed up 173.252 points or 4.14 percent to 4,363.117 points.
Shanghai Jiafeng was the star on talk of a financial restructuring, surging 0.75 yuan or 10.06 percent to 8.20 yuan on volume of 2.0 million shares.
